derivation: or שֹׁמֵר; active participle of H8104 (שָׁמַר); keeper;
def: Shomer, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
